spec.title: example 285 mutant-replay (Phase 5 step 1): the constructed raw-method-fallback mutant of Boot 2.7.18 fails the bounded-label oracle where 2.7.18 holds
spec.description: The job runs python3 examples/tools/build.py 285 --task mutant-replay, the target route of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md: workflow plans the task from target.json, runtime prepares each revision (every pinned file acquired by the sha256 its sidecar records, refused on a mismatch; driver and adapter compiled with --release 21), runs the packet's driver over its probes in a separate JVM per revision on JDK 21 and on JDK 25, and workflow ingests the records into one format-2 receipt, reading each revision's driver lines with the packet's independent oracle (controls/oracle.py problems()). A replay decides no claim: build.py exits 0 only when the receipt's matchesExpected is true, i.e. every revision ran on both JDKs, exited 0 with structured observations, and each shows what its pair's kind expects on both JDKs alike. No proof runs. For a mutation pair, runtime prepares the constructed mutant on the published-artifact route: it fetches the base commit from github.com by full SHA at depth 1, checks and applies the patch, recompiles the changed classes against the published JARs with the base class's --release and debugging flags, and puts them in place of the base JAR's classes in a copy of the JAR. The mutant is a sensitivity control (the same oracle must catch a nearby break of the fix), never a revision of Spring. The base must hold and the mutant fail. Example 285 (CVE-2023-34055, WebMvcTags.method): fixed-release is Boot 2.7.18 (0c8b382d, 14 pinned JARs from Maven Central); the mutant is 2.7.18 with controls/raw-method-fallback.patch (sha256 895a1372...), which returns the raw request method as the label when HttpMethod.resolve gives null, as 2.7.17 did. Gate A3 already passed on 285's release replay; this is the packet's mutation control.
spec.expected: build.py prints '285-...: task mutant-replay: none (completed; as expected)' and exits 0: fixed-release holds, and the mutant violates the oracle at the five trigger probes (connect, empty-token, long-token, lowercase-get, xscf) and at no legitimate probe, on JDK 21 and 25 alike; a receipt under examples/285-*/receipts/mutant-replay/
